what_it_is.prose: SpaceX operates the Falcon 9, Falcon Heavy, and Starship launch vehicles and the Starlink LEO satellite internet constellation. SpaceX has launched 4 Indian satellites to orbit (Pixxel Firefly x3, Digantara SCOT, Azista BST AFR, HEX20 Nila) via Falcon 9 rideshare in 2023-2025. SpaceX's Starlink has been in regulatory negotiation with the Indian government for a India licence since 2022; the DoT approved Starlink's licence in 2025 subject to security conditions. NSIL contracted Falcon 9 to launch the GSAT-N2 (rebadged as GSAT-20) communication satellite in November 2024 — the first ISRO satellite launched by SpaceX.

faq.question: Has SpaceX launched Indian satellites?
faq.answer: Yes. SpaceX Falcon 9 has launched 4 Indian private satellites (Pixxel Firefly x3, Digantara SCOT, Azista BST AFR, HEX20 Nila) in 2023-2025, and the GSAT-N2 (GSAT-20) communication satellite for NSIL in November 2024 — the first ISRO satellite launched by SpaceX.

faq.question: Will Starlink operate in India?
faq.answer: Starlink has been in regulatory negotiation with the Indian government since 2022. The Department of Telecommunications (DoT) approved Starlink's India licence in 2025 subject to security conditions including data localisation and government interception capability.
